question: How much annual leave am I entitled to?
answer: This document does not specify the annual leave entitlement. [NL-08:S2]

sources.title: Working Hours and Availability
sources.heading: Absence
sources.text: Planned absences are entered in the team calendar. In the event of illness, notify the manager before the usual start of work. This document does not specify the annual leave entitlement.

sources.title: Working from Abroad
sources.heading: Workation
sources.text: Workation is permitted only within the EU for a maximum of ten working days per calendar year. Requests must be submitted at least 15 working days before the start date. Approval is not guaranteed.

sources.title: Remote Work Policy
sources.heading: Allowance
sources.text: Up to three remote-working days per calendar week are permitted with manager agreement. Required team meetings on site take priority. Unused remote-working days cannot be carried over to the following week.

sources.title: Access Requests
sources.heading: Time limits
sources.text: Administrator privileges are granted for no more than seven calendar days and require a new request afterwards. Shared user accounts are prohibited. Standard access is disabled at 18:00 German local time on the final working day when an employee leaves.

sources.title: Travel Expense Policy
sources.heading: Hotel costs
sources.text: For business travel within Germany, the standard hotel limit is EUR 120 gross per night, including breakfast. A higher rate requires written manager approval before booking. Document NL-11 also applies during trade fairs.
